title: Mitigating Distribution Sharpening in Math RLVR via Distribution-Aligned Hint Synthesis and Backward Hint Annealing
abstract: arXiv:2604.07747v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), challenging math questions whose sampled groups remain uniformly incorrect yield no informative update, letting easier questions dominate actor updates. This imbalance can contribute to distribution sharpening: low-$k$ accuracy improves while problem coverage contracts. Hint scaffolding can restore informative updates by revealing a prefix of a verified teacher solution. However, existing hint-based approaches still face two issues: teacher--student distribution mismatch and the need to reduce hint exposure to match no-hint evaluation. We address these issues through two components. Distribution-Aligned Hint Synthesis (DAHS) constructs verified teacher hints conditioned on student-style responses. Backward Hint Annealing (BHA) anneals hint exposure across length buckets as bucket accuracy improves. BHA also uses per-question hint dropout to keep no-hint rollouts throughout RL

translated_title: 通过分布对齐提示合成与反向提示退火缓解数学RLVR中的分布锐化
translated_abstract: 在使用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中，那些采样组始终全部回答错误的困难数学问题无法产生有信息量的更新，导致较简单的问题主导了actor的更新。这种不平衡会引发分布锐化：低k准确率提升的同时问题覆盖范围却在收缩。提示脚手架可以通过展示经过验证的教师解答前缀来恢复有信息量的更新。然而，现有的基于提示的方法仍面临两个问题：教师与学生之间的分布不匹配，以及需要减少提示暴露以匹配无提示评估。我们通过两个组件来解决这些问题：分布对齐提示合成（DAHS）以学生风格的回答为条件构建经过验证的教师提示；反向提示退火（BHA）随着各长度区间准确率的提升，逐步对该区间的提示暴露进行退火。BHA还采用按问题的提示丢弃机制，在整个强化学习过程中保持无提示的rollout。
tldr: 该论文提出分布对齐提示合成（DAHS）和反向提示退火（BHA）两种方法，通过生成以学生风格回答为条件的验证教师提示，并随各长度区间准确率提升逐步减少提示暴露，从而缓解数学RLVR训练中的分布锐化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Distribution-Aligned Hint Synthesis (DAHS) and Backward Hint Annealing (BHA), which construct verified teacher hints conditioned on student-style responses and gradually anneal hint exposure as bucket accuracy improves, to mitigate distribution sharpening in math RLVR.
